verdict.rationale: Vast.ai documents a first-party `vastai` agent skill that lets AI coding assistants drive the platform on the user's behalf: creating instances, deploying endpoints, managing SSH keys and checking balances. That supports natural-language operation, and the llms.txt and full CLI coverage help with this. However, it only works through an external AI assistant; there is no native natural-language interface in the product itself. Missing for 10: a built-in natural-language console or chat interface, depth of operation coverage and reliability of the skill, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
